text: Comparing fabric real-time to databricks structured streaming — the same problems, two different engines.

Eventstream versus read stream. KQL database versus delta tables. Window nodes versus group by window. Watermark settings versus with watermark. Every row here solves the identical underlying problem.
The real difference is no-code versus code-first. Fabric's canvas is configured through a UI. Databricks is PySpark, written and version-controlled like any other program. Neither is simply better.
Choose fabric if you're already using no-code tools and want something running fast. Choose databricks for existing PySpark skills or complex custom logic. Many real teams actually use both together.
Same vocabulary, same computer science, different tradeoffs. Next up: putting the whole chapter together — a real-time NYC taxi dashboard, start to finish.
